about: Targeting.Choose on a 9x5 grid for every mode and pick, zones, clicks, seeds, new targets per pulse, debris, skills that aim at no cell and a fallen party. Rolls use System.Random(seed * 7919 + pulse), so rolled anchors are parity only for the candidates.

inputs.note: Each case's targeting replaces the named skill's; the zone it names is the zones fixture's Zones.Cells.
